results.description:
He stole her childhood. Now she wants it back.

"One of the best plot twists I've ever read" 

Damian Caslocke never thought he'd see his wife's sister, Mara, alive again.

She was only eleven when she was abducted from a tent in her parents' garden nineteen years ago.

So when the police announce she's been found wandering barefoot and confused in woodland, close to the house where she was taken, Damian is as shocked as everyone else .

Suffering severe psychological trauma, Mara's refusing to explain what happened to her – or where she's been all this time.

Not that her sister, Lucia, cares. She just wants to bring her home, against Damian's better judgement.

He's convinced there's more to Mara's story than meets the eye and that she's a danger to his two young children.

The only way to protect them is to prove what really happened to her - even if she's not ready to give up her secrets yet…

His Wife's Sister is a breath-taking psychological thriller that will grab you by the throat from the first page until the twisted last...

"Hooked straight away...and blindsided by the twist" – JULIET McD
